state.intent: Show the current market price chart and provider technical summary directly in the visual morning market-prep dashboard.
state.existing: Next16 React19, MorningBoard light/dark --panel --text --text-muted --accent --border, six instrument buttons and daily/weekly/monthly selectors, saved snapshot picker, gauge plus catalyst rail, reviewed developments cards, macro charts. 390px phone and 900-1400px desktop. Existing TradingViewWidget isolates official hosted chart/technical frames with attribution, delay labels and error/retry links.
catalog: stacked chart and collapsible technical panel
constraints: Use current selected ETF; MARKET shows explicitly labelled SPY benchmark, never a fabricated all-market price
The current provider display is not saved consensus evidence and must never enter model/history; hide it on past editions
Chart and technical defaults follow daily/weekly/monthly; provider controls can adjust the display and must remain available
No screenshot recreation or fake market values
Keep provider attribution/error state/delay display and keyboard navigation
Lazy load frames near viewport; stack on small screens; do not overwhelm first-screen consensus
Place after reviewed developments and before macro charts

market_layout.instructions: Choose one layout that best fits a visual morning read while keeping a clearly separate current-provider boundary.

criteria.paired_panels: Large current chart beside a smaller provider technical-summary panel; shared heading explains current display and selected benchmark, stack on phones.
criteria.chart_with_disclosure: Full-width chart with an expandable provider technical summary directly below; less initial density.
criteria.tabbed_provider: One panel with Price / Technical tabs; requires an extra action to compare the views.
